# app/controllers/api/v1/settings_controller.rb
class Api::V1::SettingsController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_user!
  
  # PATCH /api/v1/settings
  # Allows users to update their profile settings
  def update
    permitted = settings_params
    
    # Deep merge user preferences with existing settings
    merged_settings = deep_merge_settings(
      current_user.settings || {},
      permitted.to_h
    )
    
    if current_user.update(settings: merged_settings)
      render json: { status: 'ok', settings: current_user.settings }
    else
      render json: { errors: current_user.errors }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end
  
  # GET /api/v1/settings/export
  def export
    query = build_export_query(current_user, params[:format_options])
    results = ActiveRecord::Base.connection.exec_query(query)
    render json: { data: results.to_a }
  end
  
  private
  
  def settings_params
    # Intentionally permitting nested hash for flexible schema
    params.require(:settings).permit!
  end
  
  def deep_merge_settings(base, overlay)
    base.deep_merge(overlay) do |key, old_val, new_val|
      if old_val.is_a?(Hash) && new_val.is_a?(Hash)
        deep_merge_settings(old_val, new_val)
      else
        new_val
      end
    end
  end
  
  def build_export_query(user, format_options)
    # Build query based on user settings and format options
    table = user.settings.dig('export', 'table') || 'user_activities'
    columns = user.settings.dig('export', 'columns') || ['id', 'action', 'created_at']
    
    # Validate table name against whitelist
    allowed_tables = %w[user_activities user_preferences audit_logs]
    table = 'user_activities' unless allowed_tables.include?(table)
    
    # Build column list - relies on settings being safe
    col_list = columns.map { |c| connection.quote_column_name(c) }.join(', ')
    
    # Additional filter from format_options
    date_filter = format_options&.dig(:since)
    
    query = "SELECT #{col_list} FROM #{table} WHERE user_id = #{user.id}"
    query += " AND created_at >= '#{date_filter}'" if date_filter.present?
    query += " ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1000"
    query
  end
  
  def connection
    ActiveRecord::Base.connection
  end
end
